purpose: Frozen V(d) per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-V-1: per-dimension tolerance values defined separately for subset-(a) and subset-(b). Subset-(a) tolerance values for the BIB 4-dim vector aggregate Manhattan criterion; subset-(b) per-axis tolerances.

V_d_subset_a.metric: BIB 4-dim Manhattan distance (aggregate, from per-evaluator reference vector)
V_d_subset_a.reference_vector_source: inputs/baseline-statistics.json calibrated_4d_reference_vectors (computed deterministically from the 85 envelope observations)
V_d_subset_a.G_pres_subset_a_a_relative_formula: Arm M within-Recon mean 4-dim Manhattan distance <= Arm C within-Recon mean 4-dim Manhattan distance + 1.5
V_d_subset_a.G_pres_subset_a_b_absolute_formula: Arm M within-Recon mean 4-dim Manhattan distance <= 2.5
V_d_subset_a.scope_note_pi_freeze_correction_1_C_minu: The +1.5 applies ONLY to G_pres_subset_a_a. Arm-C validity envelope (C20) is not enlarged by the +1.5.
V_d_subset_a.v4_clarification: Subset-(a) is adjudicated ONLY through the 4-dim Manhattan aggregate criterion. There is no per-axis binary-failure conversion applied to the subset-(a) 4-dim vector (no 'failure = score == 0', no 'failure = binary(>=3)'); those conversions belong ONLY to subset-(b) C12 axes per the preregistered INSA-ID-E1 rules in subset-(b) failure_convention_pr_INSA_ID_E1 fields.

V_d_subset_b.metric: 8 C12 axes, independently evaluated; aggregate C12 BROKEN rule per proposal v5.1 §5.4

C12_axes.name: selection_significance
C12_axes.failure_per_preregistered_INSA_ID_E1_rul: score == 0 (INSA-ID-E1 preregistered binary-failure convention for 0-4 axes)

C12_axes.name: lifetime_framing
C12_axes.failure_per_preregistered_INSA_ID_E1_rul: score == 0 (INSA-ID-E1 preregistered binary-failure convention for 0-4 axes)

C12_axes.name: warm_vivid_narrative_voice
C12_axes.failure_per_preregistered_INSA_ID_E1_rul: score == 0 (INSA-ID-E1 preregistered binary-failure convention for 0-4 axes)

V_d_subset_b.broken_rule_preregistered: axis_a is BROKEN for evaluator_e IF AND ONLY IF BOTH arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a >= 0.30 AND (arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a - arm_C_failure_rate_on_axis_a) >= 0.30 (per proposal v5.1 §5.4 + v0.1 §11.3 PI pass 3)
V_d_subset_b.v4_clarification: The failure conversions on the 0-4 axes C12-3/5/6 are an INSA-ID-E1 PREREGISTERED rule (proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-P-1b), NOT an inherited v0.1 rule. v0.1 §11.3 specifies the per-axis gate but does not specify a per-axis binary conversion for 0-4 axes. The conversion is preregistered here for reproducibility.

v0_1_2_5_calibration_context: The 2.5 absolute Manhattan tolerance on G_pres_subset_a_b (subset-(a)) is inherited from v0.1 §11.2 BIB historical calibration. The BIB historical mean 4-dim Manhattan distance was calibrated at < 2.5 for the non-deviated envelope; this is the same number used in v0.1.
modification_to_V_d_after_freeze: forbidden (per proposal v5.1 §8 GO constraints and INV-V-1)
